title: The dua after the Adhan
intro: How the adhan began, and the dua we say after it.

learn.html: One night a companion of the Prophet (SAW), ‘Abdullah, dreamed of a man in green clothes carrying a bell. ‘Abdullah wanted to buy the bell to announce the prayer time and call people to the masjid, but the man offered to teach him something better – and recited the adhan.

The next day ‘Abdullah told Muhammad (SAW) about his dream. The Prophet said the dream was true and told him to go to Bilal, who had a beautiful voice, and teach him the words. So Bilal called the first adhan.

Allah gives special mercy when the muezzin calls the adhan – all of nature hears and understands it. We stop what we are doing, get ready for Salah and repeat the words. When the muezzin says Hayya ‘alas-salaah and Hayya ‘alal-falaah, we say: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaahil-‘aliyyil-‘azeem.

learn.label: The dua after the adhan
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
learn.tr: Allaahumma rabba haadhihid-da‘watit-taammati was-salaatil-qaa’imati, aati Muhammadanil-waseelata wal-fadeelata wad-darajatar-rafee‘ata, wab‘ath-hu maqaaman mahmoodanil-ladhee wa‘adtah, innaka laa tukhliful-mee‘aad.
learn.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and of the prayer about to begin, give Muhammad the special place in Jannah and every good and the high rank, and raise him to the praised station You promised him. Truly, You never break Your promise!

learn.html:
When the muezzin began the adhan,
from every side it rang out:
the warm voices of muezzins
from many minarets around.

Mirza trembled like a little bird,
his whole heart was thrilled –
Allah’s name was heard everywhere,
“Allaahu akbar” echoed out.
(R. Kadić, English translation)
Listen and repeat: Dua after the Adhan.
